Preparation and inference chunks are retained with eval=FALSE. Knitting uses the saved networks and begins consensus analysis after setup.

##Load packages and WGCNA objects from ShootWGCNA
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(here)
in_dir <- here("Data", "data_for_publication")
grn_dir <- file.path(in_dir, "GRN_analysis")
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(readr)
library(knitr)
library(WGCNA)

# Ensure WGCNA's cor is used
cor <- WGCNA::cor
```

##Load ShootWGCNA objects
```{r load-wgcna, eval=FALSE}
wgcna_rds <- file.path(in_dir, "WGCNA_analysis", "ShootWGCNA_objects.rds")

if (!file.exists(wgcna_rds)) {
  stop("ShootWGCNA_objects.rds not found. Run Section03_WGCNAnalysis.Rmd first.")
}

wgcna_obj <- readRDS(wgcna_rds)
datExpr <- wgcna_obj$datExpr
moduleColors <- wgcna_obj$moduleColors
MEs <- wgcna_obj$MEs

cat("Loaded WGCNA objects: ", nrow(datExpr), " samples x ", ncol(datExpr), " genes\n", sep = "")
cat("Modules: ", paste(unique(moduleColors), collapse = ", "), "\n", sep = "")
```

##Set Output directory

```{r output-dir}
out_dir <- grn_dir
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
cat("Output directory: ", out_dir, "\n", sep = "")
```

##Extract genes from modules correlated with selected traits with r >= |0.5| and p.adj <0.05

```{r select-module-genes, eval=FALSE}
target_modules <- c(
  "green", "magenta", "midnightblue", "skyblue", "white",
  "black", "red", "cyan", "turquoise", "lightcyan",
  "pink", "royalblue", "darkgreen", "lightyellow", "brown"
)

gene_ids <- if (!is.null(names(moduleColors))) names(moduleColors) else colnames(datExpr)

if (length(gene_ids) != length(moduleColors)) {
  stop("Length mismatch between gene IDs and moduleColors.")
}

selected_module_genes <- tibble(
  gene_id = gene_ids,
  module  = moduleColors
) %>%
  filter(
    module %in% target_modules,
    grepl("^MtrunA17_", gene_id)   # keep only real Medicago gene IDs
  ) %>%
  distinct(gene_id, module) %>%
  arrange(module, gene_id)

module_counts <- selected_module_genes %>%
  dplyr::count(module, name = "n_genes") %>%
  arrange(match(module, target_modules))

kable(module_counts, caption = "Gene counts in selected modules")
cat("Total selected genes: ", nrow(selected_module_genes), "\n", sep = "")

write_csv(selected_module_genes, file.path(out_dir, "selected_module_genes.csv"))
write_lines(selected_module_genes$gene_id, file.path(out_dir, "selected_module_gene_ids.txt"))
```

##Map Arabidopsis TFs to Medicago Mt5.0 orthologs

```{r map-at-tfs-to-mt, eval=FALSE}
at_tf_file <- here("MT_genome", "Athaliana.TFs_mTERFsremoved.csv")
ortholog_file <- here("MT_genome", "Mt_At_Pv_Ms_Ortholog.csv")

if (!file.exists(at_tf_file)) stop("Missing file: Athaliana.TFs_mTERFsremoved.csv")
if (!file.exists(ortholog_file)) stop("Missing file: Mt_At_Pv_Ms_Ortholog.csv")

at_tfs <- read_csv(at_tf_file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  transmute(At_ortholog = toupper(trimws(GeneID))) %>%
  filter(At_ortholog != "") %>%
  distinct()

mt_tf_map <- read_csv(ortholog_file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  dplyr::select(Mt5.0, At_orthologs) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Mt5.0), Mt5.0 != "", !is.na(At_orthologs), At_orthologs != "") %>%
  separate_rows(At_orthologs, sep = ";") %>%
  transmute(
    Mt5.0 = trimws(Mt5.0),
    At_ortholog = toupper(trimws(At_orthologs))
  ) %>%
  filter(At_ortholog != "") %>%
  inner_join(at_tfs, by = "At_ortholog") %>%
  distinct(Mt5.0, At_ortholog)

all_expressed_TFs <- mt_tf_map %>%  # all TFs expressed in your data
  filter(Mt5.0 %in% colnames(datExpr)) %>%
  distinct(Mt5.0) %>%
  pull(Mt5.0) %>%
  sort()

Mt_TF_list_annotated <- tibble(LOCUS_TAG = all_expressed_TFs) %>%
  left_join(mt_tf_map, by = c("LOCUS_TAG" = "Mt5.0")) %>%
  mutate(PRODUCT = NA_character_) %>%
  dplyr::select(LOCUS_TAG, PRODUCT, At_ortholog)

cat("Total Arabidopsis TFs: ", nrow(at_tfs), "\n", sep = "")
cat("Mapped Medicago TFs: ", n_distinct(mt_tf_map$Mt5.0), "\n", sep = "")
cat("Expressed Medicago TFs in dataset: ", length(all_expressed_TFs), "\n", sep = "")
write_csv(mt_tf_map, file.path(out_dir, "AT_to_Mt5.0_TF_map.csv"))
write_lines(all_expressed_TFs, file.path(out_dir, "Mt5.0_TF_ids_in_expression.txt"))
write_csv(Mt_TF_list_annotated, file.path(out_dir, "Mt_TF_annotation.csv"))
```
##Prepare data needed for network inference

```{r prepare-network-inference-data, eval=FALSE}
network_out <- file.path(grn_dir, "network_inference_inputs")
dir.create(network_out, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

module_gene_ids <- selected_module_genes %>%
  distinct(gene_id) %>%
  pull(gene_id) %>%
  sort()

deg_file <- file.path(in_dir, "DEG_analysis", "DEG_all_coefficients_combined.csv")
if (!file.exists(deg_file)) {
  stop("DEG file not found: ", deg_file)
}

deg_gene_ids <- read_csv(deg_file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  filter(
    gene %in% colnames(datExpr),
    grepl("^MtrunA17_", gene)
  ) %>%
  distinct(gene) %>%
  pull(gene) %>%
  sort()

deg_only_gene_ids <- setdiff(deg_gene_ids, module_gene_ids)
network_target_ids <- sort(union(module_gene_ids, deg_gene_ids))

# Keep the TF regulator input unchanged; add all expressed DEGs as network targets.
network_gene_ids <- union(network_target_ids, all_expressed_TFs)
network_expr_matrix <- t(datExpr)[network_gene_ids, , drop = FALSE]

expr_with_gene <- cbind(Gene = rownames(network_expr_matrix), network_expr_matrix)

write_lines(all_expressed_TFs, file.path(network_out, "GENIE3_CLR_TF_list.txt"))
write_lines(network_target_ids, file.path(network_out, "network_target_gene_ids.txt"))
write_lines(deg_only_gene_ids, file.path(network_out, "DEG_gene_ids_outside_selected_modules.txt"))

write.csv(network_expr_matrix, file.path(network_out, "GENIE3_CLR_expression_matrix.csv"), row.names = TRUE)
write.table(expr_with_gene, file.path(network_out, "ARACNE_expression_matrix.tsv"),
            sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)
write.table(expr_with_gene, file.path(network_out, "OutPredict_expression_matrix.tsv"),
            sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)
write.table(all_expressed_TFs, file.path(network_out, "ARACNE_TF_list.txt"),
            row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)
write.table(all_expressed_TFs, file.path(network_out, "OutPredict_TF_list.tsv"),
            row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)

cat("Total expressed genes: ", ncol(datExpr), "\n",
    "Selected module genes: ", length(module_gene_ids), "\n",
    "Expressed DEG genes outside selected modules: ", length(deg_only_gene_ids), "\n",
    "Network target genes (module genes + DEGs): ", length(network_target_ids), "\n",
    "TF regulators: ", length(all_expressed_TFs), "\n",
    "Network genes: ", nrow(network_expr_matrix), "\n",
    "Saved to: ", network_out, "\n", sep = "")
```

## 5. Run network inference (CLR and GENIE3)

```{r run-network-inference-clr, eval=FALSE}
library(minet)

# CLR expects samples x genes
expr_for_clr <- t(network_expr_matrix)
dim(expr_for_clr)

clr_mim <- build.mim(expr_for_clr, estimator = "spearman")
clr_network <- clr(clr_mim)

clr_links <- as.data.frame(as.table(clr_network))
colnames(clr_links) <- c("regulatoryGene", "targetGene", "weight")

# Keep only the unchanged TF regulators, module/DEG targets, and exclude self-regulation
clr_links <- clr_links[clr_links$regulatoryGene %in% all_expressed_TFs, ]
clr_links <- clr_links[clr_links$targetGene %in% network_target_ids, ]
clr_links <- clr_links[clr_links$regulatoryGene != clr_links$targetGene, ]

cat("CLR edges (after removing self edges): ", nrow(clr_links), "\n", sep = "")
hist(clr_links$weight, breaks = 50, main = "CLR link weights")
```

```{r run-network-inference-genie3, eval=FALSE}
library(GENIE3)

n_cores <- max(1, parallel::detectCores() - 1)
weight_matrix <- GENIE3(
  network_expr_matrix,
  regulators = all_expressed_TFs,
  nTrees = 1000,
  nCores = n_cores
)

tf_in_matrix <- intersect(all_expressed_TFs, rownames(weight_matrix))
target_in_matrix <- intersect(network_target_ids, colnames(weight_matrix))
genie3_sub <- weight_matrix[tf_in_matrix, target_in_matrix, drop = FALSE]
genie3_links <- as.data.frame(as.table(genie3_sub), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
colnames(genie3_links) <- c("regulatoryGene", "targetGene", "weight")
genie3_links <- genie3_links[genie3_links$regulatoryGene != genie3_links$targetGene, ]

cat("GENIE3 edges (after removing self edges): ", nrow(genie3_links), "\n", sep = "")
hist(genie3_links$weight, breaks = 50, main = "GENIE3 link weights")
``` 

```{r export-network-results, eval=FALSE}
network_results_out <- file.path(grn_dir, "network_inference_results")
dir.create(network_results_out, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

write.csv(clr_links, file.path(network_results_out, "CLR_network.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(genie3_links, file.path(network_results_out, "GENIE3_network.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

cat("Saved network results to: ", network_results_out, "\n", sep = "")
```

## Constructing Consensus Network using Ranking from CLR, GENIE3, ARACNE, and OutPredict

```{r load-tf-candidates}
tf_file <- file.path(grn_dir, "network_inference_inputs", "GENIE3_CLR_TF_list.txt")
deg_file <- file.path(in_dir, "DEG_analysis", "DEG_all_coefficients_combined.csv")
required_inputs <- c(tf_file, deg_file)
missing_inputs <- required_inputs[!file.exists(required_inputs)]
if (length(missing_inputs) > 0) {
  stop("Missing consensus input(s):\n", paste(missing_inputs, collapse = "\n"))
}
Mt_TF_candidates <- tibble(Mt5.0 = trimws(read_lines(tf_file))) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Mt5.0), Mt5.0 != "") %>%
  distinct()
# Saved TF candidates already restrict regulators to expressed genes.
deg_gene_ids <- read_csv(deg_file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  filter(!is.na(gene), grepl("^MtrunA17_", gene)) %>%
  distinct(gene) %>%
  pull(gene) %>%
  sort()
cat("Loaded TF candidates:", nrow(Mt_TF_candidates), "\n")
```

```{r load-network-results-and-preprocess}
network_dir <- file.path(grn_dir, "network_inference_results")

clr_file <- file.path(network_dir, "CLR_network.csv")
genie3_file <- file.path(network_dir, "GENIE3_network.csv")
aracne_file <- file.path(network_dir, "ARACNE_network.csv")
outpredict_file <- file.path(network_dir, "OutPredict_network.csv")

required_files <- c(clr_file, genie3_file, aracne_file, outpredict_file)
missing_files <- required_files[!file.exists(required_files)]
if (length(missing_files) > 0) {
  stop("Missing network file(s):\n", paste(missing_files, collapse = "\n"))
}

clr <- read_csv(clr_file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(CLR_Rank = rank(-weight)) %>%
  filter(regulatoryGene %in% Mt_TF_candidates$Mt5.0)

genie3 <- read_csv(genie3_file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(genie3_Rank = rank(-weight)) %>%
  filter(regulatoryGene %in% Mt_TF_candidates$Mt5.0)

aracne <- read_csv(aracne_file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(aracne_Rank = rank(-weight)) %>%
  filter(regulatoryGene %in% Mt_TF_candidates$Mt5.0)

outpredict <- read_csv(outpredict_file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(outpredict_Rank = rank(-weight)) %>%
  filter(regulatoryGene %in% Mt_TF_candidates$Mt5.0)
```

```{r construct-consensus-network}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(readr)
})

report_network_counts <- function(network_df, label) {
  n_tfs <- n_distinct(network_df$regulatoryGene[!is.na(network_df$regulatoryGene)])
  n_targets <- n_distinct(network_df$targetGene[!is.na(network_df$targetGene)])
  n_edges <- nrow(network_df)
  cat(label, "\n")
  cat("  Number of TFs:", n_tfs, "\n")
  cat("  Number of target genes:", n_targets, "\n")
  cat("  Number of edges:", n_edges, "\n")
}

consensus <- clr %>%
  dplyr::select(regulatoryGene, targetGene, CLR_Rank) %>%
  dplyr::full_join(
    genie3 %>% dplyr::select(regulatoryGene, targetGene, genie3_Rank),
    by = c("regulatoryGene", "targetGene")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::full_join(
    aracne %>% dplyr::select(regulatoryGene, targetGene, aracne_Rank),
    by = c("regulatoryGene", "targetGene")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::full_join(
    outpredict %>% dplyr::select(regulatoryGene, targetGene, outpredict_Rank),
    by = c("regulatoryGene", "targetGene")
  ) %>%
  mutate(GeoMeanRank = (outpredict_Rank * genie3_Rank * aracne_Rank * CLR_Rank)^(1 / 4))

report_network_counts(consensus, "Step 1: Big consensus network")

deg_genes <- deg_gene_ids

consensus_deg_tf <- consensus %>%
  filter(regulatoryGene %in% deg_genes)

report_network_counts(consensus_deg_tf, "Step 2: Consensus network after keeping DEG TF regulators only")

threshold <- quantile(consensus_deg_tf$GeoMeanRank, 0.03, na.rm = TRUE)

# Filter the top 3% strongest consensus edges after DEG TF filtering
consensus_filtered <- consensus_deg_tf %>%
  filter(GeoMeanRank <= threshold)

report_network_counts(consensus_filtered, "Step 3: DEG-TF consensus network filtered to top 3% edges")

consensus_tf <- unique(consensus_filtered$regulatoryGene)
```


```{r plot-network-degree}

  filter(!is.na(regulatoryGene), !is.na(targetGene))
out_degree <- degree_df %>%
  dplyr::count(regulatoryGene, name = "out_degree")
in_degree <- degree_df %>%
  dplyr::count(targetGene, name = "in_degree")
cat("Out-degree nodes (TFs):", nrow(out_degree), "\n")
cat("In-degree nodes (targets):", nrow(in_degree), "\n")

old_par <- par(no.readonly = TRUE)
par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
hist(
  out_degree$out_degree,
  breaks = 40,
  col = "steelblue",
  border = "white",
  main = "Out-degree distribution",
  xlab = "Out-degree (edges per TF)"
)
hist(
  in_degree$in_degree,
  breaks = 40,
  col = "darkorange",
  border = "white",
  main = "In-degree distribution",
  xlab = "In-degree (edges per target)"
)
par(old_par)
```
